_source: Remaster rule data, not in the DOS monster table. Indices are monsters.json 'index' (names repeat: ORANGE DRAGON). See DIFFERENCES.md.

_fields.undead: D-024 (user: manual) — DISPELL UNDEAD affects these. Manual p.15: skeletons, zombies, ghosts and others returned from the grave. DOS used per-monster XP % 7 == 0, which also hit BANTIR (1), DEMON (48), HIGH DEMON (60).
_fields.never_flees: D-021 (user: manual + recommended rule) — a successful FEAR only lowers L (DOS L -= 6) and never makes these run, so the FEAR + DISSOLVE Black Lord win stays (endgame.md).
